historical_entries.notes: Audit: appears TWICE, verbatim, same attribution (Ch6 and Ch8). Not located in the Aristotelian corpus; attested only on quote sites, which variously credit Aristotle, Plato, Socrates and Laozi - a signature of an unsourced attribution. The underlying maxim is the Delphic 'Know thyself'.
